mapper.select: SELECT -- IFNULL(round(SUM(dl.dFapDiff), 0),0) / 1000 AS totalUsage round(IFNULL(SUM(dl.dFapDiff), 0) / 1000 / m.dValidInstrInteger, 0) AS totalUsage FROM aptho h JOIN meter m ON h.nSeqMeter = m.nSeqMeter JOIN sgp.data_lp dl ON m.Mid = dl.Mid JOIN aptdong d ON h.nSeqAptDong = d.nSeqAptDong JOIN site s ON d.nSeqSite = s.nSeqSite WHERE dl.dtDttmHI = #{dtDttmHI} and dl.dFapDiff >= 0 and s.bSysInstall = 1
